author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Grand Theft Auto 6 is out now for everyone, and reviews—including our own glowing 10 out of 10 review—praise the wealth of activities you can do in the game. But one thing you can't do in GTA 6 is pick up sex workers. Rockstar explained why that feature, which was something you could do in the previous GTAs going back to GTA 3, has been removed, and it's simply a story thing. The game's narrative is very focused on Jason and Lucia and how much effort you want to put into cultivating their relationship, something that picking up prostitues would distract from. In other news, Gamestop's CEO is very much not happy with Rockstar's decision to release GTA 6 digital-only. And finally, more than two million players used the 'New Zealand trick' to play the game as early as 3am on Wednesday.

#IGN #Gaming #GTA6
title: GTA 6 and the Case of the Missing Prostitutes - IGN Daily Fix

description:
Check out the latest trailer for the anime, Fool Night! All episodes start streaming on Thursday, November 26, 2026, only on Netflix. In their first collaboration, Sunrise and Shaft present "Fool Night".
Transfloration — a technology that implants seeds into the bodies of those near death, transforming them into plants. It is the desperate measure humanity has chosen to ensure its survival.
In a distant future where thick clouds cover the sky, trapping Earth in constant winter and night, most of the planet’s vegetation has withered away. Facing a serious oxygen shortage, humanity has built a society that relies on the meager amount of oxygen provided by Transfloration.
A young man, Toshiro Kamiya, lives in poverty and works hard to pay taxes, cover living expenses, and afford medication for his mentally ill mother. However, the cruel reality around him gradually eats away at his hope.

#IGN #Anime

Check out the teaser trailer for The Nightingale, an upcoming drama film starring Elle Fanning, Dakota Fanning, Edmund Donovan, Albrecht Schuch, Shira Haas, and Mark Rylance.

Based on Kristin Hannah's bestselling novel, The Nightingale stars real-life sisters Elle and Dakota Fanning together onscreen for the first time in the powerful, emotional story of two sisters forced to embark on separate courageous, dangerous paths in a fight for survival and freedom during World War II.

The screenplay for The Nightingale is by Dana Stevens and Ann Peacock. The film is produced by Dakota Fanning, Elle Fanning, Brittany Kahan Ward, Reese Witherspoon, Lauren Neustadter, and Elizabeth Cantillon. Executive producers are Emily Ferenbach, J. Michael Williams, and Kristin Hannah.

The Nightingale, directed by Michael Morris, opens in theaters on March 19, 2027.

author: IGN
description:
This video is designed to point you to some of GTA 6’s best side missions. While there are no story spoilers , I'll guide you to each quest-giver to make sure you don’t miss them!

Jason and Lucia’s story in GTA 6 is so compelling that you’ll be tempted to mainline their epic tale. But outside those main missions are some of Leonida’s weirdest and most wonderful encounters, with multi-stage storylines that you’ll rarely be able to guess where they end up. Trust me, you don’t want to risk skipping the game’s best side activities. 

Don’t worry, we won’t be revealing how these quests develop. Instead, we'll just show where to start them, or, in instances where these missions will come directly to you, why you won’t want to pass on something that looks underwhelming on the surface. Anyway, let’s get on with it. Here are 7 optional missions in GTA 6 you won’t want to miss.
title: 7 Optional Missions in GTA 6 You Won't Want to Miss

author: IGN
description:
GTA 6’s open world is one packed full of distractions. 

After its short prologue and quick drug-running operation around the fictional Florida Keys, you wake up as Jason, ready to continue his crime-centred day job as a collections man for his boss, Brian. Three different main mission markers are then offered to you, ushering you into the familiar GTA rhythm you’ll likely spend much of the next 100 hours moving to. But the real beauty of what makes this game so special is the unpredictability of what happens in between those major moments, and the choices you make both in and out of missions. 

This is how the first two hours teaches you everything you need to know about the next 100 hours in GTA 6.
title: GTA 6’s First Two Hours Teach You Everything You Need to Know About The Next 100

author: IGN
description:
Take a look at the announcement trailer for Stay Human!, an upcoming chaotic co-op ambulance simulator set during a zombie apocalypse. Stay Human! will be available on PC.

In Stay Human!, every call is a race through a city crawling with zombies. Your driving can make or break the rescue. Knock zombies out of the way and dodge obstacles. Take a corner too hard? Your teammate doing CPR won't thank you for that. Hit the antidote injector? You might speed up the bitten patient's transformation instead. Your job is to get the patient to the hospital before they become a zombie.

#IGN #Gaming
title: Stay Human! - Official Announcement Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Illegal Operations are GTA 6's version of bandit camps, offering opportunities to take down rival gangs, collect valuable loot, and make some easy money. But what exactly are these activities, what rewards can you find, and which ones should you tackle early in the game?

In this GTA 6 guide, we explain how Illegal Operations work, including the valuable loot you can find, how to know when you've collected everything, and why stealth can be a better approach than going in guns blazing. We'll also highlight two early Illegal Operations worth checking out: Strange Noises in Key Lento and Fishing Shacks near Cottonmouth Lake. Plus, we'll explain how the game's opening mission, Gone Fishing, introduces you to these activities.

For more help exploring Leonida, check out IGN's GTA 6 Strategy Guide at IGN.com for interactive maps, collectible locations, secrets, and more. https://www.ign.com/gta
title: GTA 6: What Are Illegal Operations?

author: IGN
description:
Looking to expand your arsenal early in GTA 6 without spending a fortune at Ammu-Nation? There are several powerful Unique Weapon Variants hidden throughout Key Lento and the surrounding areas that you can pick up for free, giving you access to shotguns, sniper rifles, revolvers, assault rifles, and even a .50 Cal Pistol.

In this GTA 6 guide, we'll show you where to find some of the best free early weapons, including the Unpacked Comshot 12 Shotgun, Cruel Huntsman's SM-69 Sniper Rifle, Swamp Bait Akulus Revolver, Drug Mule KZ-59 Assault Rifle, Conspiracist Type 9 Machine Pistol, and Convict Kalings .50 Cal Pistol. We'll also show you where to find the Hauners H-AT Launcher.

Whether you're looking for more firepower to tackle Illegal Operations or just want to build up your arsenal without spending money, these are some of the best weapons to grab early in GTA 6.
title: GTA 6: Best Early Weapons You Can Get for FREE (No Spoilers!)

Following a brief dip down to 5 stars in GTA 5, the full six-star wanted level system is back in GTA 6. As you begin your new criminal adventure, you might be wondering exactly what you need to do to trigger the largest police response to your fiendish Vice City activities. How do you hit the full 6 stars?

The short answer is: become a psychopath. The longer answer is a little more complicated, requires quite a bit of effort, and arguably involves relinquishing each of your morals one by one. Here’s how I got a six-star wanted level in GTA 6.
